import re

TITLE = re.compile(r"^(?P<title>[A-Za-z][\w ]*):\s*$")
KV = re.compile(r"^(?P<key>[A-Za-z][\w ]*?):\s+(?P<value>\S.*?)\s*$")
LEGEND = re.compile(r"^\[(?P<col>[\d.]+)\]: (?P<meaning>\S(?:.*?\S)?)\s*$")
RESOURCE = re.compile(r"^\[(?P<index>[\d.]+)\]\s+- (?P<resource>\S+)\s*$")
HEADER = re.compile(r"^\[[\d.]+\](?:\s+\[[\d.]+\])*(?:\s+Instructions:)?\s*$")
TOKEN = re.compile(r"\S+")


def cells(header, row):
    starts = [m.start() for m in TOKEN.finditer(header)]
    out = []
    for n, s in enumerate(starts):
        e = starts[n + 1] if n + 1 < len(starts) else len(row)
        v = row[s:e].strip().replace("\t", " ")
        out.append("" if v == "-" else v)
    return out


def parse(lines):
    skip, summary, summary_lines = [], {}, []
    legend, legend_lines, resources, resource_lines = [], [], [], []
    names = {}
    tables = []
    section, header, cur = "", None, None
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            header = None; cur = None; continue
        m = TITLE.match(ln)
        if m:
            section = m.group("title"); skip.append(i); header = None; cur = None; continue
        if header is None and HEADER.match(ln):
            header = ln
            cols = []
            for t in TOKEN.findall(ln):
                cols.append(names.get(t, t).rstrip(":"))
            cur = {"name": section, "kind": "table", "lines": [i], "records": [], "cols": cols}
            tables.append(cur); continue
        if cur is not None:
            vals = cells(header, ln)
            cur["records"].append(dict(zip(cur["cols"], vals))); cur["lines"].append(i); continue
        m = LEGEND.match(ln)
        if m:
            names["[" + m.group("col") + "]"] = m.group("meaning")
            legend.append({"column": "[" + m.group("col") + "]", "meaning": m.group("meaning")})
            legend_lines.append(i); continue
        m = RESOURCE.match(ln)
        if m:
            names["[" + m.group("index") + "]"] = m.group("resource")
            resources.append({"index": "[" + m.group("index") + "]", "resource": m.group("resource")})
            resource_lines.append(i); continue
        m = KV.match(ln)
        if m and not section:
            summary[m.group("key")] = m.group("value"); summary_lines.append(i); continue
    blocks = [{"name": "summary", "kind": "kv", "lines": summary_lines, "records": [summary]},
              {"name": "instruction info legend", "kind": "table", "lines": legend_lines, "records": legend},
              {"name": "resources", "kind": "table", "lines": resource_lines, "records": resources}]
    for t in tables:
        blocks.append({"name": t["name"], "kind": "table", "lines": t["lines"], "records": t["records"]})
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": skip}
